base: Use case: illustration-story. Edit/recompose the character reference for Kalistar collectible card art. Preserve the established character identity, costume, weapon, race and painterly handcrafted fantasy aesthetic. The second image is Momo, a style/emotional sensitivity reference only: do NOT copy his robot, hat, pose, flute or blue palette. Aim for a meaningful instant from a story, emotion through eye direction, body tension and a clear human relationship, not a glamour pose. Portrait 4:5. The crucial face, hands, emotional object and secondary face must fit in the CENTRAL 60% WIDTH, between 15% and 80% height, as stat rails cover the outer edges in the final card. Paint warm-cool environmental light and selective expressive brushwork, quiet backgrounds, readable silhouettes. Avoid collage, game UI, frame, typography, logos, over-rendered particles, duplicated objects, broken fingers, melted straps. Produce ONE finished illustration.

scenes.13: TAULIO. Character identity reference: original Taulio card. Massive dark teal industrial protector robot, square head with ONE green lens, bulky rounded shoulder plates, unmistakable luminous yellow-white HEART-SHAPED chest core, two large articulated metal fists, no mouth. Full-body UPRIGHT profile facing LEFT beneath a closing rusted scrapyard blast door, one immense shoulder wedged under the door to keep it open, hands at his sides tightly clenched. NO OTHER CHARACTER. Through the opening lies a recently evacuated trail of small footprints leading into daylight. His green lens tracks the footprints, slight lowered head conveys immense gentle concern despite strain in chassis. Emerald industrial ambient light and yellow core, painterly like Momo. Low eye-level camera, foot braced on scrap, no leap, no Superman pose, no repeated exchange. One robot, two arms, two legs. Preserve heart core and fists. No UI or typography.
scenes.14: MOMO, LE BAL DES OBJETS PERDUS. Preserve tiny sad blue-eyed robot, wide shabby hat, cloth cape, delicate articulated mechanical body and silver transverse flute from reference. For once an UNGUARDED MOMENT OF JOY: full-body standing ON ONE FOOT atop a flat washing-machine shell in the scrapyard, the other leg lifted slightly in a spontaneous dance. His two small mechanical hands hold the flute coherently horizontally at his face; one single straight flute. Around his head three small salvaged brass bells hang from taut wires, catching soft electric sparks from his music. He tilts his head BACK LEFT into dawn, no audience, no second person, no humanoid objects. A broad hopeful peach and pale turquoise morning sky rather than blue night. Strong dynamic vertical silhouette with lots of breathing space, rhythm and shy freedom, NOT seated or crouched. Hand-painted emotional storytelling, no stage concert grandeur.
scenes.15: CANA, L'ADRESSE EFFACEE. Winged Falco messenger from reference, injured folded feather wing, short brown hair, ivory cloak and bow carried on back. Full-height back view slightly from LEFT, standing straight in cold greenish rain against a sealed house doorway in Nestown. One shoulder and side of her face visible as she looks up at the EMPTY scraped nameplate above door, no readable letters. A sealed letter she has just slid under the door remains half visible at the threshold. Her right arm has fallen to her side, fingers relaxed and helpless; posture conveys finality and a promise delivered too late. No recipient, no second person, no hovering flight, no looking at camera. Wet dark door wood and a few cold rain lines; a tiny warm window reflected in a puddle but the house remains silent. Face central upper third, posture and absent address tell story. No text, no game frame.
scenes.16: MALINIA, LE PREMIER DEGEL. White-haired human watcher in same blue-grey winter attire with one crystal sceptre. A WIDE LONG SHOT with one small full-body upright figure standing at the edge of a thawing lake, on a narrow tongue of ice in a vast quiet dawn landscape. The person fills about half the image height, central, with clear profile facing LEFT and head lifted into first sunlight, eyes open in vulnerable relief. Her sceptre points down, no spell, arms relaxed rather than reaching to anyone. Great horizontal cracks and open water reflect soft mint dawn, distant mountains pale lavender-grey. Winter releasing its hold as she allows herself not to be needed. No crouch, no memory prism at cheek, no other people, no interaction, no hero spellcasting. Delicate painterly light and a poignant sense of scale, emotionally spacious scene.
scenes.17: AELIS, LA PRIERE SANS REPONSE. Preserve dark golden-skinned Aurelion healer, very short tightly curled pale blond hair, elegant ear shape, ivory/gold embroidered robes. View directly FROM BEHIND with a calm strict symmetrical architectural composition: she kneels alone before the LAST small vigil flame in a long broken sanctuary, head bowed deeply, hands folded on her lap, staff resting horizontally beside her. Her shoulders make her exhaustion and patient faith visible without showing a face. The small candle is in the centre beyond her head, rows of already lit votives lead away into rainy dark green-grey cathedral stone. No other character, no floating lantern pieces, no blessings exchanged, no stereotyped glamorous face. The posture of someone choosing to keep watch when no answer comes. Central medium full-body kneeling silhouette; no extra limbs. Detailed tactile oil-painted textiles but muted gold, no brown monochrome.
scenes.18: LOK, LA GREVE DU FER. New character based on dwarven Kalistar lineage and Momo painterly universe. Stocky ADULT dwarf foreman with a close-cropped rusty beard, shaved temples, one battered iron work glove, charcoal leather apron over oxblood wool shirt; distinctly DIFFERENT face and costume from elderly white-braided Balmhyr. Full-body forceful SIDE-ON walking stance toward RIGHT at the exact moment he has yanked a rail switch and stopped a mine conveyor. One hand still holds a simple large upright LEVER, his free fist stays rigid against his thigh; his square face looks straight ahead with anger mixed with fear of consequences. A single short war HAMMER securely on belt, not another item held. Motion of conveyor stopped, dark iron wheels and falling ore frozen behind; cold silver mine light, red cloth accent, a few dull embers. ONE person, no rescued apprentice, no exchange, no huge magic spectacle. Refusal and courage, understandable industrial scene and grounded anatomy.
scenes.19: BELROG, LE SILENCE DE LA MONTAGNE. New Rhinoz scout of Zarok, same clearly rhinoceros-headed humanoid species as Nazar reference but distinct lean older build, weathered pale grey hide, a chipped smaller horn, dark charcoal fur-lined travel coat, stone grey bronze-trimmed armor. PORTRAIT LONG SHOT at a mountain pass after avalanche: Belrog stands at centre upright in back three-quarter LEFT view with profile eye visible, both boots planted wide on pale fractured rock, hands low resting on the handle of a short heavy MACE planted like a walking aid. A battered signal standard has just been righted nearby, no letters, no person. He watches a tiny first warm beacon across the enormous valley, hopeful waiting and fatigue visible in his lowered shoulders and lifted eye. Cold mauve twilight, pale snowy stone, one tiny distant warm light. Not pushing a cart, not crouching, not hero roar, no second character, no giant magic orbs. Hand-painted contemplative world scale.
scenes.20: VERMINIA, LES LIENS ROMPUS. Pale dark-haired vampire dissident from reference, same burgundy dress and identity. A CLOSE UPPER-BODY scene seen slightly from BELOW: she stands straight inside an austere private library, eyes lifted with restrained fierce anger and tears, lips pressed shut. ONE open tome lies on desk in lower foreground, incomprehensible faded marks with no readable text. One hand is raised palm-out at chest level with a thin magical crimson thread stretched between thumb and index, the other hand holding an ancestral wax seal near the book. The thread has just SNAPPED, two ends curling apart. Clear small decisive gesture and believable fingers. Her face lit on one side by pale moonlight, other side by reflected scarlet, background deep desaturated green, no candle-brown palette. No servants, no other people, no closed gate reprise, no self harm, no blood wound or gore, no magical cloud. Emotional rupture and self-determination, no profile glamour pose.
